newsitem.title: PERU: Strong tremor shakes Peru, no damage reported.
newsitem.headline: Strong tremor shakes Peru, no damage reported.

text.p: A strong tremor shook Peru on Tuesday, but there were no immediate reports of damage.

The tremor at 12:10 p.m. (1710 GMT), was felt along Peru's Pacific coast, including Lima, for about a minute and reached central parts of the country as far as Cusco, around 730 miles (1,165 km) east of the capital.
There was no immediate word on the magnitude or epicentre of the tremor.
